method: One run, synthetic 6000 flows and 6000 messages; current schema; ANALYZE; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN only, no throughput benchmark.

plans.name: recent_list
plans.sql: SELECT id,url,method,status_code,size FROM flows ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

plans.name: domain_filter
plans.sql: SELECT id,url,method,status_code,timestamp FROM flows WHERE hostname_matches(url,?)=1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?

plans.name: method_filter
plans.sql: SELECT id,url,method,status_code,timestamp FROM flows WHERE method=? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?
plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

plans.name: body_substring
plans.sql: SELECT id,url,method,status_code,timestamp FROM flows WHERE (url LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR request_body LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR response_body LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?

plans.name: per_flow_messages
plans.sql: SELECT * FROM stream_messages WHERE id>? AND flow_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH stream_messages USING INDEX idx_stream_flow (flow_id=? AND id>?)

plans.name: protocol_messages
plans.sql: SELECT * FROM stream_messages WHERE id>? AND protocol=? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH stream_messages USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)

plans.name: exact_origin_method
plans.sql: SELECT id,url,method,status_code,timestamp FROM flows WHERE origin=? AND method=? ORDER BY timestamp DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH flows USING INDEX proposed_origin_method_time_id (origin=? AND method=?)
